research_subquestion: Do frozen LPWM particles preserve readable object category and state after NAVSIM adaptation, conditional on observed GT localization?
interpretation: LPWM frozen; only deterministic linear ridge readouts are fitted on train recordings.
Observed GT boxes/tracks are used for pooling; this is not autonomous detection or tracking.
No future image, box, pose or label enters feature extraction. No planner training.
Include all eligible current objects without a particle-support or top-K exclusion.
Selection of ridge strength uses an internal recording split of train, then refit on all train.
Existing development recordings are not an independent test set.
This diagnostic does not replace the historical gate or automatically start Stage2.
Pixel instance masks, causal future readouts and trained-planner interventions remain separate follow-up evaluations.
